remarks: Filter classes to be confirmed by an air quality sampling of chloride and PM10
text: Filtration against salt and dust: the outdoor air intakes of all conditioned buildings shall have weather louvres with drift eliminators (removal of at least 99 % of droplets above 10 microns at the design face velocity of 2.5 m/s or less), followed by a G4 pre-filter and an F7 filter; the control building, electronic rooms, MV / LV rooms, UPS and battery rooms and the GIS building shall have a final F9 filter (EN ISO 16890 ePM1 >= 80 %), and the control building and electronic rooms shall in addition have an E10 EPA filter (EN 1822) or gas-phase filtration to keep the airborne chloride and sulphur gases at the ISA 71.04 severity G1 level.
